messages:
alex_infra: Hey team — got a heads up from the forwarder, one of the H100 pallets is on hold at FRA customs due to a paperwork mismatch. AWB shows 3 units flagged, ETA now T+4 instead of T+2. Can vendor confirm if we can accept partial release?
maria_ops: Ugh. Which serials are flagged? any DOA/return notes?
kevin_vendor: Sorry, just saw this. Forwarder says HS code entry mismatch for the chassis batch. They gave a provisional release for 9/12 units, but the manifest serials 5-7 are blocked. We can either wait for reclassification (3–5 days) or request a partial crossdock release.
darren_logistics: Partial release ok from our side if we can get the 9 units within 48h and label them as "priority pool". We need AWB + forwarder pick-up ETA and proof of temporary transfer.
alex_infra: If we take 9 now, can we patch capacity shortfall with loaners for EU clusters? We're down ~60% on capacity in eu-west-1 if we lose those 3.
maria_ops: Yes please prioritize getting that lane open. Also, what's the replacement workflow for the blocked 3 — RMA or outright replacement?
kevin_vendor: Vendor offer: we can ship 3 replacement units from our FRA depot on expedited air (24h) but it'll be billed as priority RMA (20% expedite surcharge) unless we classify as DOA warranty. We think it's a paperwork issue so warranty terms should apply, but need your sign-off to route as RMA.
srebot: Alert: Cluster eu-west-1 reported 14 degraded pods due to GPU shortages in the last 30m. Manual scaling of non-critical workloads recommended.
darren_logistics: Kevin — send commercial invoice + provisional AWB. Also need the forwarder sign-off PDF for partial release. Send to customs@redwood with subject "FRA PARTIAL RELEASE".
kevin_vendor: Uploading docs now, AWB: `AWB-FRA-855-3321` — provisional release attached. Invoice marked as "warranty replacement" but flagged by FRA agent.
alex_infra: Maria/Darren — decision needed: accept partial (9) + expedite 3 replacements as RMA (we'll contest surcharge), or hold all until reclassify. Trade-offs: partial reduces cluster pain now but we may incur expedite surcharge and extra shipping admin.
maria_ops: Opt partial + RMA expedite. Cost hit is fine vs. SLO risk. Please contest surcharge with vendor invoice reference afterwards.
darren_logistics: On it. I'll coordinate forwarder, prep temp labels and internal transfer doc. Kevin — please confirm the serials for the expedited replacements and put them on a separate AWB.
kevin_vendor: Confirmed. Expedited AWB `AWB-FRA-855-3322`, serials to replace: SNL-4521, SNL-4522, SNL-4523. Shipping manifest set to priority RMA; we flagged chargeback code "RMA-EXP-20". We'll remove surcharge if customs accepts warranty classification.
alex_infra: Great. Quick ask — add these three serials to our inventory queue as "pending inbound - expedite" so SRE can plan.
srebot: Inventory update queued: SNL-4521,SNL-4522,SNL-4523 -> status pending_inbound_expedite. Notifying on-call.
maria_ops: Thanks. Darren — if customs refuses warranty class, escalate to procurement for credit approval.
darren_logistics: Will do. Also opening a short ticket for customs clearance SLA: `TICK-5492` — putting all docs there.
kevin_vendor: Docs uploaded, forwarder contact: Jens Müller +49 170 555 0199. ETA for 9-unit partial: 48h pickup -> 24h transit -> 72h total to our EU DC. Expedited replacements show as shipped.
alex_infra: Thanks. I'll throttle non-critical jobs and spin reserve nodes in us-west until eu pool stabilizes. Keep this thread for updates only. :thumbsup:
